description: This file contains declarations related to the RALINK MDIO driver for RT2880, including function prototypes for MDIO link adjustment, read/write operations, and port initialization.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the MDIO link settings for a given port.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a register from the MDIO bus at a specified PHY address and register.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register on the MDIO bus at a specified PHY address and register.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes the port with given private data and device node.
